name: names_in_the_woods
revision: r1 (2026-11-10): first draft from the critic's pitch notes (rank 2, develop): the cure planted, ROSA planted early, frame 1 far and backlit, the ending is the throw
caption: why do these zombies have NAMES 😶
logline: A player kid in a hamlet where every villager wears a name tag watches three named zombies walk out of the woods every night, until the night Mom goes to visit the neighbors 'in the city' and four walk out.
question: why tf do these zombies have name tags?
premise: Every villager in Milo's hamlet at the edge of a dark oak forest gets a name tag at birth; Mom's says ROSA, and Milo, the only player, got his free. Every night three zombies named TOMAS, GRETA and OLD BEN walk out of the woods. Mom says the zombies stole the tags, and that the neighbors (three empty cottages with those names on their signs) moved to the city. Every week Mom, the hamlet's cleric, takes them golden apples and a splash potion ('potion, then apple, fixes anything') and brings it all back unused, so Milo gets the apples. Nobody in the hamlet can throw anything, so Milo wins every egg fight. Tonight Mom goes to visit Tomas and says she'll be back by dark.
twist: The zombies are the neighbors, converted in a siege: a named villager keeps its name tag (and its profession outfit) when a zombie converts it. Mom has been trying to cure them every week with the vanilla cure (a splash potion of weakness, then a golden apple), but only a player can throw a splash potion and feed the apple, and villagers can't throw. She lied so her son, the one person who could do it, would never go into the woods. Tonight she stays out past dark: four zombies walk out and the fourth tag says ROSA, still holding the golden apple, her potion dropped in the grass. Milo picks it up, has a hotbar full of the apples she gave him, and throws.

world.place: a cleric's hamlet of seven cottages on a slope at the east edge of a dark oak forest, one valley west of the carpeted village (Light Sleeper)
world.easter_egg: S02: as the crane rises and looks east over the hamlet, the carpeted village of Light Sleeper sits on the far hill in the haze: red and orange carpet roofs and the white wool box of its bell. Provisional: re-check against docs/world/canon.md when it lands.

N.on_screen: Milo, the hamlet's only player (default Steve skin, a kid in the story; mixed family canon as in light_sleeper). POV for the egg fight, the chest, the potion and the throw; seen from outside in S03 (beside Mom, his own player nameplate 'Milo'), S10 and S14 (small, from behind). Hotbar: eggs (slot 1), golden apples (slot 2, 6 then 7 from S08), the splash potion (slot 3, from S13).

Mom.name: Mom
Mom.on_screen: a plains cleric villager (purple robe), name tag ROSA always visible; holds a golden apple in her crossed arms when she goes to the woods (S06, S10). After the reveal: a zombie villager in the same purple cleric robe, tag ROSA, the golden apple in her hand. One voiced line (L05), on screen.

requests.direction: A kid tells a friend the strangest true thing about his village at the edge of a dark forest: fast, bright and at full volume, never whispery or breathy; he only gets scared near the end.

lines.text: Every night, / THREE zombies / named TOMAS, / GRETA / and OLD BEN / walk out of the WOODS.
lines.say: Every night, three zombies named Tomas, Greta and Old Ben walk out of the woods.
lines.direction: one quick breath with no stop in it, bright and amazed, like the weirdest fact he knows; full volume

lines.text: Here, / villagers get / NAME TAGS / at BIRTH.
lines.direction: matter-of-fact, quick, proud of his village

lines.text: Mom's says ROSA. / I'm a PLAYER. / Mine came FREE.
lines.direction: cheerful, a little smug on the last bit, like a joke he's told before

lines.text: Mom says / the zombies / STOLE the tags.
lines.direction: repeating what he was told, fully believing it, a little indignant

lines.text: Our neighbors / moved to the CITY.
lines.direction: warm and quick and a bit too bright, a mom changing the subject; full volume, a smile on it

lines.text: Every week, / she takes them / GOLDEN APPLES / and a SPLASH POTION.
lines.direction: fast and impressed, listing fancy presents

lines.text: Potion, / then APPLE, / she says. / Fixes ANYTHING.
lines.direction: doing his mom's saying, sing-song and fond, then plain on the last two words

lines.text: Nobody / TAKES them. / So I get / the APPLES.
lines.direction: puzzled by grown-ups for a second, then delighted, a grin

lines.text: Nobody here / can THROW. / I win every / EGG FIGHT.
lines.direction: bragging, fast and goofy, the funniest line so far

lines.text: Tonight, / Mom said / she'd be back / by DARK.
lines.direction: the brightness drops a notch; plain and steady, full volume, a short beat before the last two words

lines.text: At dark, / FOUR zombies / walked out.
lines.direction: scared now but still full volume, quick, the number hits hard

lines.text: The new one / said ROSA. / She still had / the APPLE.
lines.direction: the fear turns small and plain, a breath after the name, then steady; full volume, not whispered

lines.text: Her POTION / was in / the GRASS.
Mom lied / to keep me HOME. / She can't THROW. / I CAN.
lines.direction: figuring it out as he says it, then brave and certain; the last two words loud and sure, like a wind-up before a throw

beats: S15 (POV) on 'I': the splash potion leaves the hand in a high arc toward ROSA, 5 blocks ahead; on 'CAN' it shatters on her (glass break, the grey-purple weakness splash and swirl around her). She keeps holding the golden apple.

Hold ~0.8 s: the hotbar's selection moves from the empty potion slot to the golden apples (x7), and the selected-item name 'Golden Apple' pops above the hotbar (also in the caption track as GOLDEN APPLE). The other three tags (TOMAS, GRETA, OLD BEN) are coming down the meadow behind her.
Cut. No line after the payoff, no completed cure: the viewer knows the next click (potion, then apple).
ending.loop: cause and effect: L01's three named zombies are the neighbors Mom was trying to cure, and the kid who 'wins every egg fight' is the only one who can.
